top.title: Dubai's Population Hits 4.8 Million: What It Means for Property Demand
top.impact_reason: Directly influences long-term property demand and market sentiment.
top.headline: Dubai Population Reaches 4.8 Million, Boosting Housing Demand
top.summary: The emirate has recorded a population milestone of 4.8 million residents. This growth directly drives sustained housing demand across the local market.
top.why: Population growth is a key driver of property demand.

top.title: Dubai Golden Visa: UAE Names Relatives of Foreigners Who Can Get Residence Permits Through Retirees
top.impact_reason: Changes residency eligibility and buyer demographics.
top.headline: UAE updates Golden Visa rules for retiree relatives
top.summary: The UAE has clarified which family members of foreign retirees can secure residency permits. This update affects dependent eligibility for the Golden Visa scheme.
top.why: It directly impacts residency rules and long-term family planning for buyers.

top.why: It shows continuing buyer demand and steady market recovery in Dubai.
